transcript.text:
Thanks everyone for sharing those important details. Let me make sure I've got everything straight before I write up the plan:

1. Tessa — we need to provide 6 kilograms of cucumbers for the cooking class on August 22, 2027. So we should make sure we plant enough cucumbers and plan the harvest around that date.
2. Luis — two strawberry plants go in bed 1, collected and planted on May 10, 2027.
3. Noor — bed 3 gets morning sun only, so kale goes there, watered Tuesday and Saturday mornings.

That leaves bed 2 for cucumbers to meet the cooking class commitment. For pollinators, we could plant some flowers alongside the strawberries in bed 1 or interplant with the cucumbers. Does anyone have concerns about this layout, or any thoughts on what flowers to include for pollinator support? If not, I'll draft the plan with these requirements and submit it.
